**Finding submitted: TRANSITION — missing (insert at preferred level).**

What I checked and found:
- **§ 10 Confidentiality (p0061–p0068)**: obligations to *treat* Proprietary Information confidentially, but no return-or-destroy mechanic on termination.
- **§ 13 Term (p0078)**: shifts the exit burden onto us — we must arrange a new name server within 30 days and a new hosting environment within 60 days, with no TrueLink migration assistance.
- **§ 14 Termination (p0079)**: only fixes how long TrueLink keeps serving after our notice; silent on transition help and data.
- Targeted searches for transition / migrate / export / return / delete / destroy surfaced nothing relevant (only the Y2K "transition" reference in p0060 and domain-name assistance in p0041). § 2 Hosting Services gives us log-file access and daily backups, but no exit copy of data.

Because there is no usable exit clause at all, the Agreement fails even the fallback (90 days' assistance plus 30-day export), so I inserted a single new paragraph in the termination article (which survives under § 24) carrying all six preferred elements: expiry-or-termination trigger, up to six months' assistance, then-current rates, 30-day return, machine-readable format, and certified deletion thereafter. The comment flags the 90-day/30-day export fallback as our landing zone if TrueLink pushes back.
